name: RadioGroup
purpose: Lets users choose exactly one option from a small, visible set of mutually exclusive choices.
neverUseFor: A single independent on/off choice — use Checkbox or Switch instead
Large option sets or anything needing search — use Select instead
Multiple simultaneous selections — use a Checkbox group instead
rationale: RadioGroup uses native fieldset/legend and radio inputs so arrow-key selection and the group label are handled by the browser. Like Checkbox it has one fixed 16px control outside the ADR-004 field scale, and it is for small visible sets — larger ones belong in Select.

mayExtendLocally: Define the options, legend and helper text
Choose vertical or horizontal arrangement from the documented props
mustEscalateToDS: Replacing native radios or the fieldset/legend wrapper
Adding sizes or card-style option variants

authored.name: disabled

authored.name: required
authored.description: A value must be selected before form submission.

anatomy.description: Root element — groups the legend and options for assistive tech.

Accessible group label. Sits exactly 8px above the options — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

The required indicator (*) inside the legend, text/danger, 2px (spacing/3xs) after the text — shown by `required`. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).
Layout wrapper for the option list.
Wraps one option's input, visual control, and content.
The native radio input for one option.
Visual circle — reflects checked state via CSS.
Inner filled dot shown when the option is checked.
Wraps one option's label and description.
Visible label for one option. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

Helper text for one option. Sits exactly 8px below the label — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

Helper text for the whole group. Sits exactly 8px below the options — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible group label, rendered as the fieldset's legend.

props.name: options
props.description: The list of choices. Each option: { value, label, description?, disabled? }.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction of the option list.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown below the group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every option in the group.

props.name: name
props.description: Native radio group name shared by every input. Auto-generated if omitted.

height.note: No size prop exists — each radio control is one fixed size (16px), matching Checkbox. Does not follow the ADR-004 field scale.

keyboardNav: Arrow keys — move selection between options (native radio group behavior)
Tab — moves focus into and out of the group

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: required
properties.description: Shows the danger * (radio-required) after the legend,  2px apart; text/disabled when disabled.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Show/hide part: indented 24px (16px circle + 8px) to line up with the option text.

properties.name: errorMessage
properties.description: Show/hide part: same indent; code shows it instead of the description.

figma.structure: radio-group (8px gap) > radio-legend (text + radio-required),  radio-options (12px gap,  real RadioButton instances: Free,  Pro checked,  Team,  Enterprise),  radio-description,  radio-error. Options are a fixed sample — options[] and value have no Figma property.
figma.variantCombinations: 6 variants (2026-10-20): orientation vertical/horizontal × invalid false/true,  plus disabled for each orientation (valid) — the standard rule for disabled. No state axis: hover/focus live on each RadioButton option (pattern group). invalid/disabled pass down to every option; disabled dims legend,  required * and description (text/disabled).
